==Notes==
*Only the caster receives any bonus healing from the Monk primary attribute, [[Divine Favor]].
*This will not heal [[spirit]]s because spirits are immune to [[heal]]ing.
*[[AI]] will have a very low priority in casting this spell when foes are within its range.

==Trivia==
*This skill's icon is very similar to the icon of [[Heal Other]].
